create_dataset_stream: create a StreamDataset to prepare sequential batches for language model training with fixed bptt
create_dataset_standard: create a Dataset to batch sentences by size or token count with optional shuffling and grouping
create_dataset_parallel: create a ParallelDataset for paired sentence pairs with joint batching and length-aware grouping
test_dataset_batch_sentences: test the batch_sentences method to pack variable-length sentences into a padded tensor
review_dataset_select_data: review the select_data method to filter dataset to a subset of batches or sentences
